name: SISO Stargate Library
summary: Remote viewing and psychoenergetics research, holding a three-track truth boundary between practice, evidence and theory, with 33 adjudicated claims and a commitment-based target manager.

relationships.context: Split out of the Great Library on 2026-08-07, reuniting agent/remote-viewing-research-module and agent/psychoenergetics-terrain-scan, which forked at c9e4876 with neither containing the other. The repository name was the module's own stated destination.

evidence.summary: Split executed 2026-08-07. The Great Library README states it is a catalog rather than a giant monorepo, and ADR-0005 rejected storing the People Graph database on the same grounds; working research material with executable code belongs in its own Work rather than inside the catalog.

The module recorded that it implemented the requested standalone data skeleton under its canonical path in order to avoid 'pretending that a separate siso-stargate-library repository already exists'. That repository now exists and this Work registers it.

Executed against the split repository after the filter, not merely inspected: test_target_manager.py ran 7 tests with result OK, and verify_module.py reported PASS at sources=36, claims=33, demo_targets=12, relative_links_checked=16, publication_safe_files_scanned=20. This verifies the module's own structural checks and its tamper-detection tests; it does not evaluate any remote-viewing claim.

33 claims each carry an update_gate naming the exact evidence that would change status: 14 not_established, 11 documented_record, 2 reported_positive, 2 reported_negative, 3 methodological_rule, 1 unknown. RV-C003 and RV-C004 split the same AIR source into a documented above-chance lab result and a negative finding on operational value.

The repository and exact commit resolve on GitHub at main@7f89393c7aff6c1977d29f124d1b194c9dbc40f3 with 28 commits of history carried across from branch agent/remote-viewing-research-module of sisodias/great-library-of-siso using git filter-repo path selection, not a fresh initialisation. This verifies addressability and that commit lineage survived the split; it does not assert a release, packaged artifact, or deployment, none of which exist for this Work.

license.reason: No license has been selected. Cited government records are predominantly US Government work and are referenced rather than mirrored; the module's raw-payload policy keeps external scans upstream until a governed data plane records identifier, checksum, provenance, redaction state and rights.

evidence.summary: No LICENSE file is present in the split repository and no license has been selected for the SISO-authored material. Recorded as pending rather than asserting a permissive default.
